explanation: This tracks time in the episode and ignores rewards and choices: it is 10 at every step through about trial 50, then slowly falls to about 9 by trials 55-70, 8 by trial 75, 3-4 by trials 86-92, and 0-1 from trial 94 to the end. In the late low stretch the D2 step reads 1-3 points above that trial D1 and GO when the transition was common (rare D2 stays the same or drops to 0, but jumps to 4-7 if the trial was the first rare one after a run of common ones).
